intro.title: Ask anything about Tyler
intro.body: It answers with Tyler's data in the app. It does not replace the vet: in an emergency, call the clinic.

starters.label: Ideas to start
starters.food: How much should Tyler eat at {weeks} weeks?
starters.potty: How often should I take him out to pee at {weeks} weeks?
starters.outside: When can he go outside and meet other dogs?
starters.walks: How long can he walk at {weeks} weeks?
starters.biting: How do I teach him not to bite hands?
starters.training: What can I teach him this week?

composer.label: Your question
composer.tooLong: The question is too long (up to {max} characters).

threads.emptyBody: Ask the first question and it will show up here for both of you.
threads.subtitle: {name} · {date}
threads.confirmBody: All its questions and answers are deleted for both of you. This cannot be undone.
threads.loadFailed: The conversation could not be loaded.

signedOut.title: Sign in to use the assistant
signedOut.body: The assistant is only for Tyler's parents. Sign in with your account.
signedOut.notEditor: This account is not allowed to use the assistant.

budget_exhausted.title: This month's budget is used up
budget_exhausted.body: The assistant's monthly budget has been used. It is available again on the first day of next month, or the limit can be raised in the settings.

daily_limit.title: You reached today's question limit
daily_limit.body: You can ask up to {limit} questions a day. You can keep asking tomorrow.

disabled.title: The assistant is turned off
disabled.body: It is disabled in the settings. Turn it back on to keep asking.

not_editor.title: This account cannot use the assistant
not_editor.body: Only Tyler's parents' accounts can ask questions.

upstream_error.title: The assistant could not answer
upstream_error.body: Something went wrong getting the answer and nothing was saved. Try again.

server_error.title: Something failed on the server
server_error.body: The question could not be completed. Try again in a moment.

unauthorized.title: Your session expired
unauthorized.body: Sign in again to keep asking.

bad_request.title: The question could not be sent
bad_request.body: Check the text and try again.

not_found.title: This conversation no longer exists
not_found.body: It may have been deleted. Start a new conversation.

network.title: No connection
network.body: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet and try again.

faq.title: Save to FAQ
faq.drafting: Writing the question and answer in Spanish and English…
faq.intro: Review and edit before saving. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
faq.question: Question
